usageNotes: Use this to audit backup coverage across the entire cluster — it returns every QEMU VM and LXC container that is not included in any configured backup job. Requires the Sys.Audit privilege at the root path (/), so API tokens must carry that permission. The response is cluster-wide regardless of node; no filtering parameters are available, so post-filter client-side if you need results scoped to a specific node or type.

examples.summary: List all guests with no backup coverage

tips: An empty array means all guests are covered — treat a non-empty result as a backup gap that needs remediation.
The 'name' field in each result is optional and may be absent for guests that have no display name set.
Cross-reference VMIDs against your backup job configurations in /cluster/backup to determine which job to add the guest to.
This endpoint reflects backup job configuration, not backup execution history — a guest appears here if it is excluded from all jobs, even if a manual backup was recently run.
